description:
## Why

The x509-limbo Tier-2 baseline (PKIX-g9vc.4, see `pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-analysis.md`) builds pkix-path with default features (`["rsa", "p256"]`) per the harness's "what does the default consumer get?" rationale. This works for most testcases, but causes 4 real-world chains to fail signature verification because they use ECDSA P-384:

* `online::apple.com` — leaf signed by Apple ICA signed by DigiCert Global Root G3 (P-384)
* `online::cloudflare.com` — same root family
* `online::akamai.com` — same root family
* `online::stackoverflow.com` — root is P-384

All four have `expected_result: SUCCESS`. With pkix-path's `p384` feature enabled (already exists per PKIX-gphz.2), they should pass.

Several `webpki::*` testcases also exercise P-384 / Ed25519 / RSA-PSS chains that the default-feature build skips.

## What

Add a secondary baseline run to the harness that builds pkix-path with **all supported signature features** enabled (`p384`, plus any others added since: `ed25519` if/when, `rsa-pss` if/when). Emit a second pair of files:

* `pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-allfeatures.{json,md}`
* Optional curated diff in `pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-analysis.md` showing the "with full crypto profile" delta.

This is operational tooling; can be a separate cargo binary in pkix-difftest, or a feature-gated reconfiguration of the existing `run limbo` subcommand.

## Acceptance

- [ ] All-features baseline JSON + MD committed.
- [ ] The 4 online::* cases flip from `signature invalid at chain index N` (StricterThanWild) to Agreement(Pass).
- [ ] webpki::* P-384/Ed25519 cases similarly flip.
- [ ] baseline-limbo-analysis.md gains a "with full crypto" section.

## Out of scope

- Adding new SignatureVerifier impls (separate beads track those).
- CI integration of the secondary run.

## Filed by

PKIX-g9vc.4 baseline analysis.
notes:
Ratified 2026-05-11 (Mark): green-light. Sub-command flag --all-features is the preferred shape; separate binary is fine if simpler to wire. Emit baseline-limbo-allfeatures.{json,md} plus a 'with full crypto' section in pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-analysis.md. Target: the 4 online::* P-384 cases + webpki::* P-384/Ed25519 cases flip from StricterThanWild to Agreement(Pass).

Ready for autonomous claim.
title: pkix-difftest: secondary all-crypto-features limbo baseline
